```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
```

## Keys

Match the pilot to Billboard using the song title and artist. Convert both
fields to lowercase, trim whitespace, and remove surrounding quotation
marks. Use the verified MusicBrainz recording ID and release date for the
pilot because the original recording ID was outside the API search results.

```{r read-inputs}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

song_key <- function(x) {
  tolower(trimws(gsub('^[“"]|[”"]$', "", trimws(x))))
}

billboard <- read_csv(
  "../data/processed/billboard_combined.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    chart_date = col_date(),
    chart_position = col_integer(),
    song_title = col_character(),
    artist_name = col_character()
  )
)

pilot <- tibble(
  song_title = "Something in the Way",
  artist_name = "Nirvana",
  confirmed_week = as.Date("2022-03-26"),
  original_release_date = as.Date("1991-09-24"),
  recording_id = "3589823f-b494-4b2d-aab3-c2e500f81175",
  article_url = paste0(
    "https://www.billboard.com/music/chart-beat/",
    "nirvana-something-in-the-way-batman-1235042829/"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    title_key = song_key(song_title),
    artist_key = song_key(artist_name)
  )
```

## Join

Find the consecutive weekly chart run that contains the confirmed week.
Compare the resulting window with the period described in the article.

```{r join-billboard}
billboard_keys <- billboard |>
  transmute(
    title_key = song_key(song_title),
    artist_key = song_key(artist_name),
    chart_date,
    chart_position
  )

pilot_weeks <- pilot |>
  inner_join(billboard_keys, by = c("title_key", "artist_key"))

if (anyDuplicated(pilot_weeks$chart_date) > 0L) {
  stop("The pilot has duplicate Billboard weeks. Check the chart rows.")
}

pilot_weeks <- pilot_weeks |>
  arrange(chart_date) |>
  mutate(
    starts_new_run = is.na(lag(chart_date)) |
      as.integer(chart_date - lag(chart_date)) != 7L,
    run_id = cumsum(starts_new_run)
  )

anchor_run <- pilot_weeks |>
  filter(chart_date == confirmed_week) |>
  pull(run_id)

if (length(anchor_run) != 1L) {
  stop("The confirmed pilot week did not match exactly one Billboard row.")
}

resurgence_weeks <- pilot_weeks |>
  filter(run_id == anchor_run)
```

## Check the join

Review the chart rows in the matched run. A missing chart week in the
source data can make the window appear shorter, so verify any uncertain
boundary before final selection.

```{r check-join}
tibble(
  pilot_rows_before_join = nrow(pilot),
  chart_rows_after_join = nrow(pilot_weeks),
  chart_rows_in_resurgence = nrow(resurgence_weeks)
)

resurgence_weeks |>
  select(chart_date, chart_position)
```

## Save the pilot dataset

```{r save-pilot}
pilot_summary <- resurgence_weeks |>
  summarise(
    song_title = first(song_title),
    artist_name = first(artist_name),
    recording_id = first(recording_id),
    original_release_date = first(original_release_date),
    article_url = first(article_url),
    resurgence_start = min(chart_date),
    resurgence_end = max(chart_date),
    peak_rank = min(chart_position),
    weeks_charted = n_distinct(chart_date),
    age_at_resurgence_years = round(
      as.numeric(resurgence_start - original_release_date) / 365.25,
      1
    )
  )

pilot_summary

write_csv(pilot_summary, "../data/processed/resurgence_pilot.csv")
```
